evaluation.feedback: The track has a really infectious, bouncy groove that blends acoustic guitar with a modern trap-style rhythm section. I liked the clean production and how the syncopated guitar riff interacts with the 808 bass. It feels very polished and professional, though as an instrumental, it becomes a bit repetitive over time. It serves as an excellent foundation for a song, but could benefit from a lead melody or vocal to give it more of a focal point.
evaluation.suggested_prompt: Make me a chill hip-hop song with a catchy acoustic guitar riff and punchy 808s, but include a melodic synth lead or a vocal hook to add more variety to the structure.
